codeReview.summary: The feature correctly moves @types/xlsx from dependencies to devDependencies in package.json, with corresponding package-lock.json updates. All verification steps pass (npm install, tsc --noEmit, 206 tests). However, the commit also bundles unrelated devDependencies additions (@eslint/js, eslint, prettier, typescript-eslint) that were pre-existing in the working directory but not part of this feature's scope.

issues.description: Commit 45d4117 includes unrelated dependency additions (eslint, prettier, typescript-eslint, @eslint/js) beyond the @types/xlsx move. The commit message only describes the @types/xlsx change, making the scope misleading. The worker acknowledged this in the transcript but chose to include them anyway. While these are harmless devDependencies additions, it conflates the commit's purpose.

summary: The fix correctly moves @types/xlsx from dependencies to devDependencies, fulfilling VAL-DEP-011. The current state of package.json confirms @types/xlsx exists only in devDependencies and is absent from dependencies. All expected behavior criteria are met: npm install succeeds, tsc --noEmit passes, and all 206 tests pass. Minor note: the commit bundled unrelated eslint/prettier dependency additions that should ideally have been in a separate commit, but this does not affect the correctness of the feature implementation.
